question: True or false: NASA spends more than 5 cents of every dollar in the US federal budget?
answer: False. NASA's 2023 budget of about $25 billion was about 0.4% of federal spending, under half a cent per dollar. Its share peaked in 1966, during the race to the Moon, at a little over 4%. Launches on the evening news make it look far bigger than its line in the accounts.
move: Loud spending is not the same as big spending; check the share.
ask: Which cost in my own budget do I overestimate because it is the one I notice most?
trap: True, because NASA is in the news far more than most agencies.
source: Office of Management and Budget, Historical Tables
reference: Office of Management and Budget, Historical Tables, Budget of the U.S. Government, Fiscal Year 2025, 2024
